movie.title: Tomorrow, You Pretty Ghost
movie.overview: Two high school theater kids, prone to playing elaborate tricks on their pals, pull off one last prank before graduation with grim consequences.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: A group of high school friends finds their attempt to stay in touch turning into a chilling nightmare in this blend of dark comedy, drama, and horror.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: In *Tomorrow, You Pretty Ghost*, maintaining high school friendships proves far more terrifying than simply growing apart. As time moves on, a tightly knit circle of former classmates attempts to preserve their bond despite changing lives and unspoken resentments. However, their routine catch-ups take a dark turn as past trauma and ghostly encounters begin to haunt their gatherings. The line between nostalgic connection and sinister obsession blurs in this unsettling blend of comedy, drama, and horror.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Years after graduation, a group of high school friends vows to keep their close connection alive through regular reunions and digital check-ins. What starts as a comforting tradition gradually becomes strained as adult responsibilities, shifting priorities, and unresolved conflicts emerge. Tension escalates when strange, unnatural occurrences begin to follow their group interactions, suggesting that something unnatural is clinging to their shared past. As subtle eerie phenomena escalate into terrifying hauntings, the group is forced to confront deep-seated secrets they thought were buried long ago. Bitter rivalries and old grudges surface alongside supernatural threats, testing whether their bond is built on genuine love or toxic codependency. One by one, the friends realize that their relentless hold on youth and each other has summoned a sinister presence that refuses to let them move on. Balancing dark humor with genuine emotional weight, the story highlights the horror of emotional stagnation. Ultimately, the survivors must decide whether to break the supernatural curse by letting go of their past or remain bound forever to a terrifying ghost of their youth.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: A dark, atmospheric horror-drama infused with comedic moments, *Tomorrow, You Pretty Ghost* examines the emotional and supernatural terrifying consequences of refusing to let go of high school relationships. The narrative follows an old group of friends whose commitment to staying in touch spirals into eerie, unexplainable events. As subtle horrors infiltrate their everyday lives, the film delivers a spoiler-free exploration of nostalgia, toxic bonds, and the frightening realities of growing up.
